about: A list of links a page is reached from: rows in a column, and branches that expand a nested list.

effect.about: A glow around the current row, in the palette's solid at half opacity.
effect.title: Effects

guide.about: Every style of the line down a nested list. The line is aligned with the centre of the branch's icon.
guide.title: Guides

highlight.about: Every highlight at every size, on the row with `aria-current`.
highlight.title: Highlights and sizes

iconic.about: The list in full and collapsed to a rail. In the rail every row is a square that contains its icon. The counts, the controls and the nested rows are hidden, and the text stays in the accessibility tree.
iconic.title: Iconic

palette.about: The eight semantic palettes, on the fill highlight. The palette sets the highlight, the hover fill and the branch rows.
palette.title: Palettes

radius.about: Every corner, on the current row.
radius.title: Corners

reveal.about: A control that is always visible, and one that appears on hover. The control on the current row stays visible. The others appear under the pointer, while their row has focus, and under a coarse pointer.
reveal.title: Reveal

title: Nav list

variant.about: A column of rows, and a dock of equal columns across the foot of a screen, each an icon over its label.
variant.title: Looks
